name: hw64-express-passport
description: RESTful API server built with Express.js following the MVC pattern, extended with logging, session, authentication, validation, access-control and error-handling middlewares, rendering HTML pages with the PUG (/users) and EJS (/articles) template engines, serving a shared favicon on every page, persisting a user-selected theme via cookies, and providing Passport-based (passport-local) registration/login/logout with the login state persisted server-side via express-session and an httpOnly session cookie to protect routes.
